module: Flowgraph node "Set Multiple Buttons Property" (category repeat_instant): same as Set Button Property for several buttons. For each i: inputs "buttonId_i", "label_i", "active_i", "order_i", "style_i". Only non-nil properties are applied.
notes: The default value of label_i is "Button": the label is therefore rewritten every frame as long as the pin keeps this value.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's state from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Writes the node's state to the save table.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the editor's custom properties panel; returns a string describing the change (for the undo history) or nil.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central area of the node in the flowgraph editor.

builder.desc: Editor node builder (builder:Middle() opens the central area).

style.desc: Node display style provided by the editor.

updatePins.desc: Adjusts the number of groups of 5 input pins (buttonId, label, active, order, style).

work.desc: For each i whose button exists, applies the non-nil properties.
